why_not_directly_observable: Alphabet discloses tax at consolidated and broad geography levels rather than at Korea product or service level and YouTube Premium is embedded inside broader Google Services reporting.
YouTube Music is disclosed as part of Alphabet's wider subscription and Google Services ecosystem so service-level Korean tax incidence cannot be isolated from official public filings.
Spotify's official filings and public service materials show Korea market exposure but not a Korea-specific tax line or a product-level Korean entity tax statement.
Apple reports tax and geography in highly aggregated buckets while Apple Music is nested inside the broader Services segment and no Korea-music-service tax line is publicly disclosed.
